steps.name: probe code
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import urllib.request; r=urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:18111/index.html'); s=r.read().decode(); assert r.status == 200 and '<title>Local profile</title>' in s"

steps.name: JSON code
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import urllib.request,json; r=urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:18111/profile.json'); p=json.load(r); assert r.status == 200 and isinstance(p['skills'],list)"
